citations.quote: Die Verwaltung Lindenhof Treuhand will das Mietverhältnis per 31. Juli 2027 beenden.
Ich schulde tatsächlich zwei Monatsmieten (CHF 3020); die Mahnung lege ich bei.
Seltsam finde ich nur, dass die Verwaltung erst so streng wurde, nachdem ich im Sommer die Nebenkostenabrechnung angefochten hatte.
Ich bräuchte also auf jeden Fall mehr Zeit, falls die Kündigung hält.
Wir fordern Sie auf, diesen Betrag umgehend zu begleichen. Erfolgt die Zahlung nicht fristgerecht, werden wir das Mietverhältnis kündigen.

plan.because: The extract lacks the contracting parties and complete agreed terms; request the full contract.
Receipt is presumed for planning because the claim does not say whether a notice was received. The reported intention to terminate is not the original notice; obtain it urgently.
The recipient and delivery date are needed urgently to assess the deadline and service.
The extract states a three-month period but does not establish the relevant termination dates.
Obtain the landlord's stated termination ground and its factual basis; the customer report and conditional warning do not establish the actual notice contents.
A spouse or registered partner is not mentioned; the family-home branch is presumed absent for planning.
The supplied warning states arrears and threatens termination but does not specify a cure period. Request any complete deadline letter or other cure-period evidence.
Arrears are reported; amounts due, payment dates and the outstanding balance must be established.
The reported challenge to service charges raises a retaliation-screen issue; obtain the correspondence and chronology.
More time and housing hardship are reported; obtain dated search efforts and responses.
This is optional under the process.

questions: Have you received a termination notice? If so, who received it and on what date? Please provide the notice and envelope or delivery record urgently so the challenge deadline can be assessed.
Did the landlord send another letter specifying a payment deadline, and what payments have been made since the warning?
